case_level.case_id: Original HUDOC item identifier (e.g. 001-210465), join key; directly linkable to the public judgment.
case_level.split: Original train / validation / test assignment. No separate physical split CSVs.
case_level.test_view: ID / OOD; not_applicable outside the test set.
case_level.test_challenging_view: yes / no; inherited metadata-based diagnostic membership, not recomputed from applicant rows.
case_level.judgment_date: Original full judgment date, YYYY-MM-DD, for chronological/retrieval restrictions.
case_level.respondent_state: Respondent state as retained in the source table.
case_level.country_alpha2: Source country code, a categorical geographic identifier, not a learned numeric encoding.
case_level.case_importance: key_case / high / medium / low. HUDOC API TermValue 1/2/3/4 corresponds to Key cases / displayed level 1/2/3, respectively. Displayed levels 1/2/3 mean high/medium/low in the official HUDOC manual. Do not confuse API values with displayed levels.
case_level.represented: yes / no / unknown from historical extraction.
case_level.hudoc_application_count: Number of distinct nonempty semicolon-delimited HUDOC application numbers in retained metadata; not a person count.
case_level.num_applicants: Retained historical case-level applicant-count proxy; not guaranteed equal to natural persons or rows of applicant_level.csv.
case_level.has_mixed_outcome: Mixed merits outcome, NOT mixed compensation heads.
case_level.violated_articles: Retained article-code collection, without one-hot encoding.
case_level.violated_articles_count: Count of distinct article codes under the retained contract.
case_level.violation_duration_months: Retained duration in months or unknown. Original fully-missing sentinel zeros are restored to unknown.
case_level.applicant_sex: Semicolon-separated distinct source-record sex labels within case; not a ratio.
case_level.applicant_age_group: Semicolon-separated distinct source-record age groups within case; not a ratio.
case_level.applicant_birth_years: Semicolon-separated distinct exact source-record birth years, including unknown where present; not a median.
case_level.applicant_nationality_scope: single/multiple/unknown from the historical case-level distinct nationality-label count; this is a case aggregate, not an individual citizenship count.
case_level.beneficiary_type: Only generic categories applicant/organisation/joint/group/unknown; case values are semicolon-separated sets. Names and free text are withheld. Target-side descriptive field, not a strict case-award predictor.
case_level.has_joint_beneficiary: yes if a retained allocation label explicitly states joint/jointly, otherwise not_found; unknown if no allocation label. Not proof the judgment has no joint award. Target-side descriptive field.
case_level.gdp_per_capita_current_usd: Original annual GDP per capita in current US dollars, not log-transformed.
case_level.gdp_constant_2015_usd: Original annual GDP in constant 2015 US dollars, not log-transformed.
case_level.y_amount_eur: Retained case-level euro benchmark label, including documented amount corrections. Mixed/unresolved rows are not certified pure NPD: read target_status.
case_level.y_binary: Existing target: 1 if y_amount_eur > 0, otherwise 0. This retained target is not a predictor encoding.
case_level.target_status: retained_label / corrected_amount / mixed_head_reference_label / unresolved_reference_label. Reference means retained historical label, NOT a second release.

applicant_level.applicant_id: Stable project-assigned applicant source-record key, not a certified unique person.
applicant_level.case_id: Original HUDOC item identifier (e.g. 001-210465), join key; directly linkable to the public judgment.
applicant_level.split: Original train / validation / test assignment. No separate physical split CSVs.
applicant_level.applicant_name: Constant [MASKED] for every source record; no original applicant names are distributed.
applicant_level.applicant_type: applicant_source_record / applicant_estate_record / organisation_record / group_or_ambiguous_record. A row is a source unit, not necessarily one living individual.
applicant_level.sex: male / female / unknown; mixed is retained only for group_or_ambiguous_record.
applicant_level.age_group: child / adolescent / adult / elderly / unknown, as extracted; no new age is imputed.
applicant_level.birth_year: Exact four-digit extracted birth year or unknown.
applicant_level.nationality: Original extracted nationality/citizenship text, including country names and historical wording; unknown where missing. Not independently normalized or verified.
applicant_level.nationality_scope: single / multiple / stateless / unknown for the source record; supplementary descriptive scope, not a numeric encoding.
applicant_level.beneficiary_type: Only generic categories applicant/organisation/joint/group/unknown; case values are semicolon-separated sets. Names and free text are withheld. Target-side descriptive field, not a strict case-award predictor.
applicant_level.npd_award_eur: Retained source-linked NPD amount in euros or unknown. Read npd_award_scope: an estate amount is for the applicant estate unit, never each heir. No joint sum is divided to invent personal awards.
applicant_level.npd_award_scope: individual / applicant_estate / group_or_organisation / unknown. Describes the recipient unit, not a model predictor.
applicant_level.npd_award_status: verified_source_link (audited recipient match), verified_source_allocation (source-stated per-applicant/estate amount; not independent person identification), retained_source_link, or an explicit missing/unresolved status. Missing never means zero.
